name: scut-learning-team
description: Explains missed lectures, adapts practice to student answers, and revises study plans after verified course updates.

displayDescription.en: Cites course materials, explains missed concepts, designs follow-up practice from student answers, and revises study plans after checking teacher notices.
displayDescription.zh: 为缺课学生查课堂出处、补讲关键概念，按真实作答出变式，核对教师改期通知并调整剩余学习安排。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I missed the condition variable lecture; catch me up with two questions.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我缺了条件变量那一讲，帮我补齐并出两道题。

quickPrompts.en: I missed the condition variable lecture; catch me up with two questions.
quickPrompts.zh: 我缺了条件变量那一讲，帮我补齐并出两道题。

quickPrompts.en: I thought any data stability before the clock edge was enough. Find the missing step and give me a follow-up question.
quickPrompts.zh: 我认为数据只要在时钟沿前稳定就满足建立时间要求。帮我看看漏了哪一步，再给我一道变式。

quickPrompts.en: Check the old and new deadlines for the Pine Needle 27 lab report and preview the changes to my plan.
quickPrompts.zh: 老师更新了松针-27实验报告的截止时间。帮我核对新旧通知，预览需要调整的安排。
